name: vscode-tab-complete
description: Inline code completions powered by the pi coding agent running as a subprocess.

vscodeTabComplete.command.markdownDescription: Command that launches the pi agent. Use `["pi"]` when VS Code runs inside WSL (Remote-WSL). Use `["wsl.exe", "-e", "pi"]` when VS Code runs on Windows and pi is installed inside WSL. The first element is the executable; the remaining elements are passed before pi's own arguments.

vscodeTabComplete.model.markdownDescription: Optional `--model` argument passed to pi (e.g. `glm-5.3-flash-nvfp4`). Empty uses pi's configured default model from `~/.pi/agent/settings.json`.

vscodeTabComplete.debounceMs.markdownDescription: Milliseconds to wait after the last keystroke before asking pi. Later keystrokes replace a pending request.

vscodeTabComplete.timeoutMs.markdownDescription: Hard limit in milliseconds before the pi subprocess is killed. Protects against hung model requests.

vscodeTabComplete.contextPrefixChars.markdownDescription: Characters of context before the cursor that are sent to pi.

vscodeTabComplete.contextSuffixChars.markdownDescription: Characters of context after the cursor that are sent to pi.

vscodeTabComplete.debug.description: Log provider activity to the 'vscode-tab-complete' output channel.
